summary: Require declared fluid ports for acquisition machines.
details: Fluid acquisition routes now require enough declared input/output ports for their distinct fluid identities on an independently acquired matching machine. Duplicate fluid product entries do not invent another required port.

The shared query index counts each machine once. Valid machines, bidirectional ports, typed item-only producers and their research frontiers remain eligible. Controlled lab/researchability fixtures preserve prototype immutability.

These necessary checks do not simulate exact slot assignment, fluidbox_index, filters, temperature, volume or pipe connectivity. Native catalogue, production, save and migration acceptance remain outstanding. No new permission, effect owner, stream identity, setting or support claim is granted.
